usage_rules.headings: Use 'Outfit' for all H1-H6. Tracking tight (-0.02em). Weight: Semibold or Bold for H1/H2, Medium for H3.
usage_rules.body: Use 'Inter' for all paragraphs and UI text. Relaxed line-height (1.6).

layout.grid_strategy: Bento Grid (Mode A) for Results Page. Asymmetric layout to highlight the 'Risk Score' as the hero element.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-12 px-8 rounded-full font-medium transition-transform active:scale-95 shadow-lg shadow-primary/20
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 h-12 px-8 rounded-full font-medium

cards.style: bg-card border border-border/50 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300 rounded-xl overflow-hidden

inputs.style: h-12 rounded-lg border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for sticky headers and result overlays. Class: 'backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b border-white/20'.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use colored shadows for primary actions. 'shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/20'.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the background to reduce digital flatness (opacity 0.03).

media.image_style: Clean, high-resolution, realistic. No cartoons. Rounded corners (xl).

motion.guidelines: Use 'spring' physics for interactions. Stagger children for lists. Page transitions: simple fade + slide up.
motion.loading_state: Use a fluid wave animation (SVG or CSS) for the analysis phase. Do not use a standard spinner.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for text. Use APCA standards.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-primary on focus.

instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Use Tailwind CSS utility classes. Avoid inline styles.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Import icons from 'lucide-react'. Example: import { Droplets } from 'lucide-react';
instructions_to_main_agent.components: Use Shadcn UI components from /components/ui. Customize them via className props to match the design system.
instructions_to_main_agent.layout_structure: Wrap the app in a main container with 'min-h-screen bg-background font-sans antialiased'.
instructions_to_main_agent.critical: Do not use gradients for text. Keep text solid for readability. Use gradients only for backgrounds or decorative elements.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
